species: domestic hen (Gallus gallus domesticus), brown speckled
origin: on the ground, centred under the body; all part origins are joint pivots

parts.head: head (includes neck, comb, wattles, upper beak, eyes; pivot = neck base)

rest_pose: standing, wings folded on flanks (authored in geometry), feet on z=0

gait.rotation_axis: X (positive X rotation about hip swings the foot backward (+Y)); head pivot: positive X pitches the beak downward
gait.head_bob: while walking: head translates/rotates about X +-6 deg in sync, phase locked to leg cycle (forward on stride)
gait.note: legs are two-part (leg_* hip, foot_* ankle). Lift foot: foot X rot +20 during back-swing, -25 at forward-swing.

wing_pose.note: rotation euler XYZ (Blender) about the shoulder pivot; wings lie folded at rest (identity). Interpolate from identity; flap by oscillating the Y component.
